_comment: Ratchet for RAW globalSetting access outside nest/src/common/settings. A file may only go DOWN. New direct access is the defect validate-settings-access.cjs exists to catch. These keys must be read through SettingsResolverService so provenance and the declared default are not bypassed. A file may legitimately REMAIN here for a DYNAMIC key that cannot be declared at all — currently automation-loop.service.ts, whose remaining 2 sites are the per-broker `automation.brokerTrading.<brokerId>` read and write (brokers are data, so there is no finite list to declare, and the resolver deliberately refuses undeclared keys). Note the consequence: those two reads do NOT fall back to a declared default, which is unchanged behaviour but is not yet covered by provenance reporting.
